Hi Olivia — thanks for the context and outline.

Quick note: the US daylight saving changeover happens on Sun Mar 14 this year (clocks spring forward). That shift will change PST offsets for meetings scheduled late on Mon/Tue night PST, and we've seen invites silently move for attendees in the US. Since you have folks in Auckland and in Dublin, we want to avoid scheduling right after the US cutover to eliminate confusion (and avoid an off-by-one-hour for east-coast attendees).

Two options that would keep things simple:
- Move the session to Tue Mar 16 at 09:00 AM NZDT (which is Mon Mar 15 5:00 PM PST / Tue Mar 16 9:00 AM GMT) — this keeps the meeting in working hours for Dublin and puts it before the US team's evening across the DST boundary.
- Or shift to Wed Mar 17 at 11:00 AM NZDT (Tue Mar 16 7:00 PM PDT / Wed Mar 17 11:00 AM GMT) if you prefer a later NZ time.

I've attached a quick timezone grid so everyone can confirm local times. If either option works, we'll send a calendar invite that includes an explicit timezone note to avoid client-side calendar changes.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
